title: naija-pay
tagline: One typed interface to Nigerian payment providers.
summary: Write your payment code once and switch providers without rewriting it. Money is always whole kobo, never decimals.
problem: Every Nigerian payment provider has a different API, and floating-point money quietly loses kobo.
note: Pre-release. The Paystack adapter is sandbox-verified; a Flutterwave sandbox harness is being added.
features: Integer kobo everywhere: naira(5_000) is 500000 kobo
Paystack adapter verified against the sandbox
why: Every Nigerian payment provider has a different API, and floating-point money quietly loses kobo. naija-pay gives one typed interface for collections, virtual accounts, split payments, payouts and webhooks.
hard: naira(5_000) is 500000 kobo: integers everywhere, never floats.
Every provider’s webhook is verified before it is trusted.
The Paystack adapter passes against the real sandbox; Flutterwave is next.
